rv.q: Pre-Existing Condition scored enthusiastic reviews in its premiere at the Connelly Theater in the far East Village in 2024.

It would be unfair to say that 'Pre-Existing Condition' sometimes feels like one [a PSA]. But I would be lying to deny that much of the drama in watching this play comes from knowing something about it that's not in the script.
Unfortunately, Pre-Existing Condition has a vagueness about it that made it hard for me to connect with.
Ireland, who based the play on her own well-publicized experience with an actor-boyfriend during a London production, has written an actorly play that allows its entire cast to shine.

cn.t: Nyong'o delivers a vulnerable performance in Ireland's nuanced drama about domestic assault's aftermath, though critics are divided on the play's quiet, understated approach to its weighty subject matter.
